item.name: Get sizing recommendations for virtual environments

request.name: Get sizing recommendations for virtual environments

description.content: Returns sizing recommendations to optimize resource allocation for machines based on historical information. Visit the Sizing Recommendations Report documentation for more details.

query.description:
Specifies which calculation method to use for sizing recommendations.

false: Calculates utilization averages across a continuous 24/7 period, regardless of whether a session is active. This includes nights and weekends when machines might be idle. If your machines have significantly different resource utilization depending on whether a session is active, then this method can under-estimate a machine's hardware requirements.

true: Only calculates utilization averages when an active user session is detected. This can provide a more realistic view of hardware requirements by excluding idle time.
The page number returned. The first page is 1.
The number of items returned per page. Minimum is 1.

query.description: (Required) Your license type for Microsoft Windows Virtual Machines. If you have Azure Hybrid Benefit, enter ‘Azure Hybrid Benefit’. If you purchase a new license for each machine, enter ‘OS (Windows)’.
(Required) The Azure region where you want to see representative costs. You must provide the name of the region as it appears in the report creation UI.
The currency used for all cost information in the report.
The discount rate percentage due to a Microsoft Enterprise Agreement. If you don’t have a discount rate, enter `0`.
Select whether you require VMs with or without Accelerated Networking. Enter `any` if you have no preference.
Select whether you require VMs with or without Memory Preserving Maintenance. Enter `any` if you have no preference.
Select the required Hyper-V generation for VMs. Enter `any` if you have no preference.
Select the required CPU architecture for VMs. Enter `any` if you have no preference.
Select the required vCPUs per core for VMs. Enter `any` if you have no preference.
Select whether you require RDMA-capable VMs. Enter `any` if you have no preference.
Select whether you require VMs with premium IO. Enter `any` if you have no preference.
Select whether you require VMs with encryption at host. Enter `any` if you have no preference.
Select your required disk tier. Enter `any` if you have no preference.
Select your required disk redundancy option. Enter `any` if you have no preference.
Select your required minimum disk size in GB. Enter `any` if you have no preference.

Your Azure cost option. Select from pay as you go (`PAYG`), spot machines (`Spot`), reserved instance for one a one-year term (`RESERVED_ONE_YEAR`), or reserved instance for a three-year term (`RESERVED_THREE_YEAR).
